item.title: What Israel wants from an Iran peace deal: No enrichment, missile limits and strict enforcement
item.description: Israel wants Iran to stop enrichment, dismantle underground nuclear sites, restrict missiles and cut ties to Hamas and Hezbollah, experts say.

item.title: Still no sign of a solution in Iran: US president says the war will be over soon
item.description: Donald Trump again says the Iran war will be over "soon"... The US president has said this in some way, shape or form a number of times in recent days.Yet, there's still no solution on the horizon in the Middle East. March 9: Trump said the war was “very complete, pretty much.” March 24: He reportedly said the U.S. and Israel had “won” the war. item.title: Israel strikes Beirut's southern suburbs, targeted 'top Hezbollah commander'
item.description: Israel on Wednesday unleashed the first air strikes in weeks on Beirut’s southern suburbs. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed the attack, saying a top commander of the Iran-backed Hezbollah militant group was targeted in the operation. Read our liveblog to see how all the day's events unfolded.

item.title: IDF claims to have taken out Hamas commander who participated in Oct 7
item.description: The IDF announced it killed Hamas Nukhba Commander Anas Hamed in a targeted Gaza airstrike, saying he raided Israel during the Oct. 7 Nova massacre.

item.title: Fears of renewed Gaza war as Hamas disarmament talks stall
item.description: Israeli media reports suggest Israel is preparing to resume fighting because of the impasse in talks with Hamas.

item.title: Propaganda war: The Gen Z team behind Iran’s hit anti-Trump videos
item.description: Satirical Lego animations depicting US President Donald Trump as Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s puppet while casting Iran as the defender of the oppressed mark the latest propaganda coup for the Iranian regime in its war with the US. The FRANCE 24 Observers team spoke to one of the young Iranians behind the videos.

item.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. and Iran Exchange Fire Amid a Declared Truce
item.description: The U.S. military said it struck Iranian military targets after, it said, Iran fired on U.S. warships in the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump threatened more if Iran didn’t agree to a peace offer.

item.title: UAE says its air defenses are intercepting drone and missile fire
item.description: United Arab Emirates says its air defenses are intercepting drone and missile fire as Iran war’s ceasefire challenged

item.title: Iran accuses US of breaching ceasefire with Strait of Hormuz attacks
item.description: Iran accused the US of violating a ceasefire by targeting two ships in the Strait of Hormuz and attacking civilian areas, the country's military command said early Friday. Iran said it fired missiles on “enemy units” in the strait in retaliation for a US attack on one of its oil tankers. Follow our liveblog to see how the day's events unfolded.

item.title: Israel strikes Beirut suburbs, threatening already shaky ceasefire
item.description: The airstrike on the Haret Hreik neighborhood targeted the leader of the Radwan forces, Hezbollah’s elite and battle-hardened fighting unit, Israeli authorities said.
